dictionary.definition: to seek; to request, to demand; to beseech, to beg for

currentComponents.note: 求 originally pictured a fur coat, an early meaning later preserved in the related character 裘. Because the two words sounded alike, 求 was borrowed to represent the unrelated meaning 'to seek, to request,' which became its primary use.

dictionary.definition: sediment, dregs; to waste, to spoil

currentComponents.note: 米 (grain, rice) — 糟 originally named the dregs left over from making rice wine.
曹 (cáo) gives a sound close to zāo, sharing the same rhyme and tone.

dictionary.definition: cake, pastry

currentComponents.note: 米 (rice) — 糕 names a food made from rice or flour, a cake.
羔 (gāo) gives the sound — an exact match with 糕.

dictionary.definition: to eliminate, to remove, to wipe out

etymology.hint: The waste 余 produced by a city 阝

usedInWords.meaning: to expel (a member of an organization)

currentComponents.note: 阝 (a mound/settlement) — represents a city or town.
余 (surplus, remainder) — the leftover waste a city produces, which must be cleared away, giving 除 its meaning 'to remove, eliminate.'

dictionary.definition: appearance, looks; form, figure; to contain, to hold

currentComponents.note: 宀 (roof/house) — 容's meaning 'to contain, hold' relates to a house holding things, extended to 'appearance, to allow, tolerate.'

dictionary.definition: to change; to exchange, to trade; simple, easy

currentComponents.note: 易's oldest form has been read as a picture of a lizard or chameleon, an animal noted for changing its skin color — the likely origin of 易's meaning 'to change,' which later broadened to 'easy, simple.'

dictionary.definition: to hold, to support, to sustain

currentComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — relates directly to 持's meaning 'to hold, maintain.'
寺 (sì) served as the phonetic base; its pronunciation has since drifted well away from chí.

dictionary.definition: although, even though
to believe, to wish for; to consider, to plan, to think

currentComponents.note: 心 (heart/mind) — 想 relates to thinking, missing someone, or wanting something in one's heart.
相 (xiāng) gives the sound — 想 is pronounced xiǎng, matching aside from tone.

dictionary.definition: to possess, to occupy; position; base

currentComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — relates to 据's meaning 'to rely on, according to,' as if grasping evidence in hand.
居 (jū) gave the base sound; the pronunciation later shifted to jù, keeping the same final but a different tone.

dictionary.definition: simple, succinct, terse; a letter

currentComponents.note: ⺮ (bamboo) — 简 originally referred to bamboo strips used for writing
间 (jiān) gives a sound close to 简's reading jiǎn, sharing a similar historical pronunciation

dictionary.definition: single, individual, only; lone

currentComponents.note: Depicts an ancient forked hunting tool, sometimes shown with a net or crossbar at the top, once used to catch birds or small game. The picture was later borrowed for its sound to write the unrelated meaning 'single, alone,' a common pattern where a concrete image is repurposed for an abstract word that happened to sound similar.

dictionary.definition: to fly, to dart; high

usedInWords.meaning: (of an aircraft or rocket) to take off

currentComponents.note: A simplified pictograph of a bird's wings spread in flight — the source of 飞's meaning 'to fly.'

dictionary.definition: court; courtyard; spacious hall or yard

etymology.hint: A wide 广 couryard 廷; 廷 also provides the pronunciation

currentComponents.note: 广 depicts a roofed building or shelter.
廷 depicts an open court or hall — together with the shelter above, giving 庭 its meaning 'courtyard, hall.'

dictionary.definition: secret, mysterious, abstruse

currentComponents.note: 禾 (grain) — an older sense of 秘 was linked to grain kept out of sight, before it narrowed to 'secret.'
必 (bì) gives the sound — an exact match with 秘.

dictionary.definition: secret, confidential; intimate, close; dense, thick

etymology.hint: A silent 宓 mountain 山; 宓 also provides the pronunciation

currentComponents.note: 宓 depicts stillness and quiet beneath a roof.
山 (mountain) — a quiet, secluded mountain gave 密 its meaning 'dense, secret, close.'

dictionary.definition: body, corpse

usedInWords.meaning: (literary) to put a corpse on display (after execution)

currentComponents.note: 尸 is traditionally read as a picture of a person collapsed or bent over — the origin of its meaning 'corpse.'

dictionary.definition: body; group, class; form, style, system

currentComponents.note: 亻 (a person) — 体 concerns the human body or physical form.
本 (root, foundation) — suggests the body as a person's rooted, foundational form. This simplified pairing replaced the traditional character 體, which combined 骨 ('bone') with the phonetic element 豊.

dictionary.definition: to check, to examine, to inspect

currentComponents.note: 木 (wood) — 检 originally related to a wooden tally or label used for checking records
佥 (qiān) gives a sound distantly related to 检's reading jiǎn, having drifted apart over time

dictionary.definition: early; soon; morning

etymology.hint: The first rays 十 of the sun 日

currentComponents.note: 日 (sun) — represents the sun.
十 depicts the first rays of sunlight appearing low on the horizon — together with 日 (sun) giving 早 its meaning 'early, morning.'

dictionary.definition: to play with, to joke, to entertain

currentComponents.note: 王 (jade, written without its dot) — 玩 originally meant to handle and admire a piece of jade, extending to 'to play, to have fun.'
元 (yuán) gives a sound distantly related to wán, having drifted apart over time.

dictionary.definition: to smile, to laugh; to giggle; to snicker

etymology.hint: A person 夭 with a big grin ⺮

currentComponents.note: 夭 (a person leaning back) — the pose of someone laughing.
⺮ (bamboo-like strokes) — suggesting a wide grin, giving 笑 its meaning 'to laugh, smile.'

dictionary.definition: affairs, business; should; must

currentComponents.note: 力 (strength, effort) anchors 务/務, showing exertion put toward a task.
攴 (a hand wielding a tool) appears in the traditional 務, picturing someone striving hard at labor — together the pieces built the idea of 'duty' or 'affairs' that must be attended to with effort.

dictionary.definition: field, open space; market, square; stage

usedInWords.meaning: the scene (of a crime, accident etc)

currentComponents.note: 土 (earth) — 场 relates to a flat open area of ground, such as a field or venue.
昜 (yáng) gives a hint of the sound — 场 is pronounced chǎng, a connection that has drifted significantly over time.

dictionary.definition: to gamble, to play games; to win; rich, plentiful, extensive; wide, broad

currentComponents.note: 十 (ten) — 博 relates to breadth, with ten symbolizing completeness.
尃 (fū) reflects the character's historical phonetic root, though the modern reading bó has diverged considerably.

dictionary.definition: tense, tight, taut; firm, secure

usedInWords.meaning: to keep a firm grip on

currentComponents.note: 糸 (silk/thread) — 紧 relates to something pulled taut, as thread is pulled tight when spun, giving its meaning 'tight, tense'

dictionary.definition: to display; to expand, to open; to stretch; a sheet of paper

currentComponents.note: 弓 (bow) — relates to 张's original meaning 'to draw a bow taut,' extended to 'to open, stretch.'
长 (cháng) gives a sound hint — 张 is pronounced zhāng, sharing the same rhyme though the initial consonant and tone differ.

dictionary.definition: to release, to liberate, to free

currentComponents.note: 攵 (a hand with an implement, action) — relates to 放's meaning 'to let go, release, put.'
方 (fāng) gives the sound — 放 is pronounced fàng, a close match sharing the same rhyme.

dictionary.definition: to abandon, to discard, to reject; to desert; to forget

etymology.hint: Two hands 廾 discarding a dead, swaddled baby 亠厶

currentComponents.note: 亠厶-shaped top pictures a bundled object being cast away.
廾 (two hands) below shows the act of throwing it out, giving 弃 its meaning 'to abandon, discard.'

dictionary.definition: to look at, to inspect, to observe, to regard

currentComponents.note: 见 (to see) — relates directly to 视's meaning 'to look at, view.'
礻 (a form of 示, shì) gives the sound — 视 is also pronounced shì, an exact match.

dictionary.definition: generally, probably, approximately

currentComponents.note: 木 (wood) — 概 originally referred to a wooden leveling bar used to strike excess grain off a measure, later extended to 'in general, roughly'
既 (jì) gives a sound distantly related to 概's reading gài, having drifted apart over time

dictionary.definition: to stay, to remain; to preserve, to keep; to leave a message;

currentComponents.note: 田 (a field) pairs with an element derived from 卯, whose older form suggested something held in place or detained.
Applied to a field, the combination came to mean 'to stay, to remain, to keep,' as in produce left standing rather than harvested.

dictionary.definition: formula, pattern, rule, style, system

etymology.hint: A craftsman using an awl 弋 and a measuring square 工

currentComponents.note: 弋 (an awl or tool) — one of the craftsman's instruments.
工 (a measuring square) — a tool for making things to a fixed pattern, giving 式 its meaning 'style, form, type.'

dictionary.definition: first; dollar; origin; head

etymology.hint: A man 儿 with two lines emphasizing their head 二

currentComponents.note: 儿 (a standing person) — the figure being emphasized.
二 (an extra line at the top) — emphasizing the person's head, the 'first, foremost' part of them — the source of 元's meanings 'origin, first' and, by extension, the basic unit of Chinese currency.

dictionary.definition: to supervise, to direct, to control; to inspect; prison, jail

currentComponents.note: The oracle-bone form pictured a person bending over a basin of water to see their own reflection, since polished bronze mirrors had not yet become common. That act of close observation gave rise to 监's later meanings, 'to observe, supervise, monitor.'

dictionary.definition: prison, jail; case; lawsuit

etymology.hint: A guard dog 犭 talking 讠 to a prisoner 犬

currentComponents.note: 犭 (dog) on the left represents a guard dog.
讠 (speech) suggests an accusation or a legal case being spoken.
犬 (dog) on the right completes the scene, giving 狱 its meaning 'prison, lawsuit.'

dictionary.definition: new, recent, fresh, modern

etymology.hint: A freshly chopped 斤 tree 亲

currentComponents.note: 亲 (here representing a tree, related to 榛/hazel) — 新 pictures a tree being cut.
斤 (an axe) — freshly chopping wood gave 新 its meaning of something 'new' or 'fresh.'

dictionary.definition: crazy, insane, mentally ill

currentComponents.note: 疒 (sickness) shows 疯 describes an afflicted state of mind.
风 (fēng) gives the exact sound of 疯.

dictionary.definition: insane, mad; violent; wild

currentComponents.note: 犭 (dog) — 狂 originally described a mad, rabid dog, extending to 'wild, crazy.'
王 (wáng) gives a sound distantly related to kuáng, having drifted apart over time.

dictionary.definition: to collect, to gather, to harvest

currentComponents.note: 攵 (a hand with an implement) — relates to 收's meaning 'to receive, collect, harvest.'
丩 (jiū) served as the phonetic base; its pronunciation has since drifted well away from shōu.

dictionary.definition: central; center, middle; amidst; to hit (target), to attain; China; Chinese

etymology.hint: A line 丨 through the center of a box 口

currentComponents.note: A vertical line 丨 running through the middle of a box or flag 口 — a simple image for the idea of 'center, middle.'

dictionary.definition: knot; button, handle; tie

currentComponents.note: Thread/silk — early buttons and knots were tied with thread.
Gives the sound chǒu, related to niǔ but drifted apart over time.

dictionary.definition: belt, strap; band, ribbon; area, zone; to carry, to raise, to wear

etymology.hint: A belt, creasing one's robe above 卅 but not below 巾

currentComponents.note: 巾 (cloth) — the bottom half of a belt, hanging straight down.
Above the cloth, the strokes crease as if folded at the waist — depicting a belt or sash, the source of 带's meaning 'belt, band,' later 'to bring, carry along.'

dictionary.definition: to clutch, to grab, to seize

etymology.hint: A hand 扌 with claws 爪; 爪 also provides the pronunciation

usedInWords.meaning: to keep a firm grip on

currentComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — 抓 describes an action done by hand, grabbing.
爪 depicts claws or fingers gripping something, reinforcing 抓's meaning 'to grab, to seize.'

dictionary.definition: to reside, to live at, to dwell, to lodge; to stop

etymology.hint: A person 亻 who hosts 主; 主 also provides the pronunciation

currentComponents.note: 亻 (person) — the one settling somewhere.
主 (host, master) — the idea of a person settled in a place as if hosting it, giving 住 its meaning 'to live, reside, stay.'

dictionary.definition: to copy, to record, to write down

etymology.hint: A brush used to record stories

usedInWords.meaning: variant of 記錄|记录[ji4 lu4]

currentComponents.note: 录 traditionally depicted a hand-held tool used for carving or writing records — the image behind its meaning 'to record, to write down.'

dictionary.definition: old, aged; experienced

etymology.hint: A person bent over with long hair 匕 and a crutch; compare 耂

usedInWords.meaning: variant of 老闆|老板[lao3 ban3]

currentComponents.note: 耂 (a person bent with age, with long hair) — depicts an elderly figure.
匕 (here representing a cane or walking stick) — combined with the bent figure above, 老 pictures an old person leaning on a cane.

dictionary.definition: to look back; to look at; to look after

currentComponents.note: 页 (head) — 顾 originally related to turning the head to look back at something
厄 (è) gives a sound distantly related to 顾's reading gù, having drifted apart over time

dictionary.definition: very, too much; big; extreme

etymology.hint: A giant 大 with a normal-sized man 丶 for scale

currentComponents.note: 太 adds a small dot below 大 (big) — the extra mark emphasizes something even bigger or more extreme, giving 太 its meaning 'too' or 'extremely.'

dictionary.definition: sharp (of sight and hearing); intelligent, clever, bright

currentComponents.note: 耳 (ear) shows 聪 relates to hearing, extended to mean sharp intelligence.
总 (zǒng) gives a sound close to cōng, sharing a similar consonant sound.
